items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: When I first joined Celestan's band

ctx.x: Who else was in Celestan's band at that time? At that time?

When I first joined Celestan's band, he heard Ernest Kelly playing trombone. Celestan was playing trumpet. A fellow named Abby Foster, not Abby Foster. bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo…
You were talking about Salistan's band, you say Abby Foster, Chinese, was the drummer.
